text:
nightly-bot: Nightly eval job rwd-nightly-218 flagged a quality regression for rwd-1.2-int8 on the code-gen promptset. repetition_rate@50 = 0.089 (+0.054 vs fp16 baseline). avg_entropy dropped, long loops observed. link: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/218

anya: saw this on my morning pass, pinging eng-ml. Looks like the spike started in last quant build (2026-03-14).

kevin: copying logs, trying to repro locally with the exact seed and prompt set. small repro script running now.

jess: quick snapshot: the outputs show tight token loops like `for i in range(i):` repeated and then truncated. Not typical hallucination pattern — feels like a low-entropy collapse.

liam: repro log (trimmed):
```
model: rwd-1.2-int8
prompt_id: codegen_long_loops
seed: 42
output: "for i in range(i):\n    for i in range(i):\n    for i in range(i):\n..."
repeat_rate: 0.87
entropy_avg: 1.9
```

kevin: interesting — fp16 baseline has entropy_avg ~3.8 and repeat_rate ~0.03. Will diff operators between int8 build and previous release.

anya: hypothesis: quant kernel change (softmax scaling) in latest packed-kv optimization changed effective logits scale -> lower entropy -> loops.

jess: I ran the new int8 kernel with explicit temperature scaling (temp=1.6) and repeat_rate drops back to ~0.04. So effective temperature dropped.

liam: confirmed. Looks like a missing scale factor in the quantized softmax math after the packed-kv reorder. Patch candidate: multiply logits by 1.4 pre-softmax for int8 path.

kevin: action proposals:
- rollback int8 packed-kv PR from 2026-03-14 on Dedicated builds (kevin)
- add canary gating: block int8 rollout on prod if repetition_rate@50 > 0.04 (anya)
- add automatic temperature check to nightly eval and fail build if entropy drop > 0.6 (jess)
- hotfix patch to reintroduce scale factor in kernel for next dev build (liam)

ops-bot: FYI — created ticket RW-9876 and scheduled canary job rwd-canary-int8-01 at 10:30 UTC.

anya: I'm going to pin hosted customers to rwd-1.2-fp16 for the moment and cut the int8 rollout. Who can own the rollback?

kevin: I'll do the rollback on Dedicated and Hosted staging now. Will post deploy ts.

liam: I'll open a PR for the kernel scale fix and add unit tests to assert entropy parity with fp16 for a small prompt set.

jess: I'll extend nightly eval to add the new gate. Proposed config snippet to add to eval pipeline:
```
eval_gates:
  repetition_rate@50:
    threshold: 0.04
    action: block_and_notify
  entropy_avg:
    delta_threshold: 0.6
    action: block_and_notify
canary:
  fraction: 0.01
  metric_watch: repetition_rate@50
```

anya: leaving owners: rollback (kevin), kernel fix + PR (liam), nightly gate + alert (jess), pin hosted to fp16 + comms (anya). Ops will run canary once kernel patch lands.

kevin: rollback in progress — rolling back int8 variant to rwd-1.1-int8 on staging and stopping the main rollout. Deploy start: 1714500200.

ops-bot: Deploy event recorded: deploy/rollback/rwd-1.2-int8 by kevin at 1714500230.

liam: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/542 — kernel scale factor reintroduced. Added test vector comparing entropy and repeat_rate vs fp16 (small prompt set).

jess: Nightly eval updated to include gating rules and alert thresholds. Will monitor next 3 runs.

anya: one-pager root cause for ops: quant packed-kv reorder change unintentionally removed a pre-softmax scaling factor on the int8 execution path, reducing effective temperature and causing low-entropy token loops. Mitigations: rollback, kernel hotfix, canary gating rule, nightly eval parity checks, and an automated tolerance test in CI.

kevin: moving this to high priority. Will update ticket RW-9876 with timeline and verification steps.

liam: note for postmortem: add a regression test that runs a few deterministic prompts through quant and fp16 at CI on every kernel change.

anya: thanks all. If no objections, keep canary blocked until we have parity within thresholds. End-of-thread summary will be attached to RW-9876. :white_check_mark:
